name: one-direction-equality
description: `wife = ~husband` as the inclusion wife in ~husband only.
ve: (not (there exists atom p, ((p is sig_person) and (tc[atom a, b | ((a f_mother b) or (a f_father b))](p, p))))) and (for every atom x, (for every atom y, (if (x f_wife y), then (y f_husband x)))).
